name: Eclipse
overview: Scripture uses the imagery of the sun, moon, and stars being darkened or ceasing to give light to signify profound divine intervention and judgment. Passages such as Isaiah 13:10 and Ezekiel 32:7-8 depict celestial bodies losing their brightness as a manifestation of God's sovereign power over creation and His righteous judgment. Figuratively, as seen in Isaiah 60:19 and Joel 2:31, the darkening of these lights points to the surpassing glory of the Lord, who becomes the everlasting light for His people, especially in the context of the coming 'day of the LORD.' This theme underscores that ultimate hope and illumination come not from the created sun and moon but from God Himself.
